newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish business climate warms further in August.
newsitem.headline: Polish business climate warms further in August.

text.p: Poland's overall business climate for manufactoring firms improved in August for the second month running after falling for the entire first half of the year, an official survey by the Central Statistical Office (GUS) said.
The monthly survey said the industrial climate in August rose three points from July to plus six points thanks to increased demand, especially foreign one.
Most firms expected demand to grow in the upcoming months.
The overall business climate indicator was much higher among private companies than state-owned enterprises.
GUS said however the construction climate worsened for the fourth month running in August, falling five points from July to 35 points, as ratings of current and future orders fell.
State-owned companies were more optimistic about future orders than private construction firms.
BUSINESS OUTLOOK AUGUST JULY JUNE MAY APRIL AUG 95
NOTE: The indicator is a percentage balance between positive and negative responses from polled companies.
